sample.main_thread: ggml_metal_library_init -> newLibraryWithSource -> MTLCompilerScheduler -> wait for compiler queue

finding: The observed stall precedes model loading and occurs in Metal shader-library initialization. Disabling Metal devices removes the minimal startup stall. This identifies the blocked path, not the underlying macOS compiler-service cause.
workaround_scope: CPU-only fallback for a separate temporary/new Ollama instance; existing evaluated GPU runners and user services unchanged.
source_note: Upstream backend registration reads GGML_METAL_DEVICES; installed executable contains and empirically honors this variable. Treat as version-specific rather than a guaranteed public Ollama API.
full_import_regression: See embedding-import-verification.json when the CPU replay completes.
